posts.body:
Hi,
I'm using this plugin here to offset events and stuff in maps but I have an issue that i'm hoping someone can help with.
This is the 'offset events' plugin i'm using.
https://taaspider.itch.io/taa-eventoffset
The problem..
When I load into an area that is using the offset on events, the screen loads in as it should but then the player can see all the events move. I'm wondering if there's a fix or something i'm missing to stop the player from seeing the events move? or maybe.. someone has a small add-on/edit to the plugin that can load the event designated move-to-offset locations before the screen fades in from a player teleport.
I've tried..
I tried to turn the fade off on teleport events and manually do a fade out/in on the door events, which it fades out as it should, i leave it a few seconds after the teleport, then fades in.. and the events then do the offset movement.. >.< I was hoping that the events would have moved whilst the screen was 'faded out' but they dont.
Hopefully someone can help fix this issue or make an edit to the script for me 'cos the plugin owner seems to be unavailable.

posts.author: SylarDean
posts.body:
IF i could offset using moveroute I woulda done that and not bothered using a plugin. I think your confused on what the offset plugin actually does.
Say I had a counter and i place a book on it and the book is hanging off the edge of the counter, i could put the book in an event instead, then set the offset in the 'NOTES' section of the event (which is what the plugin tells you to do) and the book would fit nice on the counter then, so it's offset. This could be used to offset a player character also, if they are not alligned properly with seat, chairs, etc. It allows you to move an item (used in an event) anywhere within the 48x48 single square.
Whilst I could DO this items thing with parallax mapping.. the issue you have then is all these little bits 'n' bobs will not be interactive because effectively its just an overlay image of item placements. NOT to mention a lot more work just to make use of a couple of items. And i'd prefer NOT to have a project made up of 20billion parallax images for my game, (over-exaggeration there).
Now, the plugin don't update events using offset in real time in the editor, it waits until you're in that map 'in-game' to offset them, even tho i'm only using NOTES section for the script code. Hence.. why i said.. the player can see the offsets moving the events to their designated spots when they enter the room.. 'cos that's what it's designed to do.
My OP, if you read it again, I was asking for a solution to actually have the offset events move BEFORE the screen fades in so the player wouldn't see them move. Where I stated what i had tried.. THAT was actually the solution to my problem but I was just missing a component in the fade in/out parallel event, my 'dumb ass' just forgot to turn off the 'fade' on the teleport function lol, tho I thought i had. So when i was entering the map it wasn't running MY own fade in/out event it was still running the teleport fade.. so players could still see the offset events moving.
Either way, its all solved now.. this help request can be closed by a mod if they like.
